view: Tiwanaku Gateway of Sun three-quarter close study of single broad rectangular andesite monolithic portal with one centered rectangular doorway and shallow carved frieze across upper lintel, weathered crack, open high Altiplano sparse grass distant mountains; no arch, no stacked blocks, no giant human face filling doorway.

eras.title: A doorway on the plateau
eras.caption: The Gateway of the Sun is carved from a single block of stone at Tiwanaku. Its sharply cut doorway and shallow reliefs stand against the open Altiplano, part of a ceremonial centre built long before the Inca empire.
